paper.title: Little Red Dots: Rapidly Growing Black Holes Reddened by Extended Dusty Flows

result.summary: 本文针对 JWST 发现的一类尘埃红化宽线活动星系核——little red dots（LRD）——提出了一套从静止系紫外到红外的光谱能量分布（SED）模型 [S1.p6]。模型假设典型 AGN 的入射辐射被一个延展的尘埃介质包裹，其消光律类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境，紫外-光学部分由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射解释，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S1.p6]。在红外波段，延展且密度集中度较低的尘埃气体分布（γ<1）使较冷尘埃主导辐射，把能量峰从近红外移到中红外，从而产生与 JWST MIRI 观测一致的 SED 平坦化 [S1.p6]。作者据此讨论了 LRD 在 z>4 的出现、v 形 SED 的普遍性以及早期黑洞宇宙学演化等问题 [S1.p6]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是 LRD 特征性 v 形 SED 的起源，即静止系光学红色连续谱与静止系紫外蓝色（或平坦）超额分别来自什么 [S1.p2]。原文指出，此前 SED 模板拟合认为光学红色部分可能来自尘埃红化 AGN 或星暴星系，紫外蓝色部分可能来自未遮蔽星系或嵌入 AGN 的散射光 [S1.p2]。此外，MIRI 观测显示多数 LRD 在 F1800W 未被探测到，且被探测源的 MIRI SED 从静止系光学到近红外趋于平坦，这与热尘埃再发射导致光学到近红外都很红的预期相矛盾 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Despite their significance, the properties of these newly identified LRDs remain puzzling, particularly concerning the origin of their characteristic v-shaped spectral energy distribution (SED).

Observational studies using SED template fitting suggested that the red optical part could either be due to dust-reddened AGNs or starburst galaxies, while the blue UV component might represent light from unobscured galaxies or scattered light from embedded AGNs.

Data from the JADES, COSMOS-Web and PRIMER-COSMOS surveys show that most LRDs are not detected in the JWST/MIRI F1800W bands, and even for the detected sources, the MIRI SEDs tend to flatten from the rest-frame optical to the near-infrared (NIR) at 1–3 $\mu$ m
Those observations appear to contradict expectations that the SED should be very red throughout the optical to NIR spectrum due to re-emission from hot dust components heated by the AGNs.

method.text: 论文提出一个覆盖静止系紫外到红外波段的 LRD SED 模型：假设典型 AGN 的入射辐射被延展尘埃介质包裹，紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，采用类似猎户座星云或 AGN 复合谱的灰色消光律，取 A_V=3 mag，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S1.p6][S2.p5]。红外部分用径向密度剖面 ρ=ρ0(r/r_in)^(-γ) 的延展尘埃气体分布计算尘埃温度与再发射，并考虑辐射压反馈把升华半径附近的热尘埃推到光球半径 [S3.p3][S3.p5]。作者还通过三个条件限定参数空间：A_V≈3 mag 的尘埃衰减、光学-近红外斜率 β_opt/NIR<-1.0、以及 ALMA 非探测要求最小尘埃温度超过 30 K [S4.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We hypothesize that the incident radiation from an AGN, characterized by a typical SED, is embedded in an extended dusty medium with an extinction law similar to those seen in dense regions such as Orion Nebula or certain AGN environments.
There is no need for additional stellar emission or AGN scattered light.
For all the cases, we assume a visual extinction $A_{\mathrm{V}}=3$ mag and normalize the attenuated fluxes at $\lambda=4000~{\rm\AA}$.
we focus not only on a compact dust structure such as a dust torus, but rather a more extended dust structure described by a radial density profile of $\rho=\rho_{0}(r/r_{\rm in})^{-\gamma}$
Radiation pressure expels dust grains between the sublimation radius and the dust photosphere to UV radiation into a thin shell that accumulates at $r=r_{\rm ph}$
1. Dust attenuation: To reproduce the rest-frame UV-to-optical SED of LRDs, the dust attenuation is set to $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag.
Here we impose $\beta_{\rm opt/NIR}<-1.0$ for this study.
This requires that the minimum dust temperature, which is analytically calculated in our SED model, exceeds a temperature threshold of $T_{\rm min}=30~{\rm K}$.

experiments.text: 论文将模型 SED 与 LRD 的堆叠测光数据比较，包括 z~5.5 和 z=7.5 的样本，以及 JADES 和 COSMOS-Web 巡天的堆叠数据 [S2.p5][S3.p6]。模型还叠加了 JWST 巡天（COSMOS-Web、CEERS、JADES-Medium/Deep）的 5σ 点源成像深度，并对比 SCUBA 和 ALMA 波段非探测给出的中远红外通量上限 [S2.p9][S3.p6]。参数研究覆盖气体密度 1≤n0/cm^-3≤10^3 与密度斜率 γ=0、1、2 等组合，并考虑有/无辐射反馈的情形 [S3.p7][S3.p10][S3.p11]。此外，作者还讨论了宿主星系贡献（f_AGN 从 100% 到 10%）对参数约束的影响 [S4.SS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: As reference, we overlay photometric SED data obtained from stacking LRD samples at $z\sim 5.5$ (orange) and $z=7.5$ (blue).
For comparison, we overlay the stacking photometric data of observed LRDs reported by the JADES survey and the COSMOS-Web survey.
Furthermore, the upper bounds of the mid- to far-IR flux densities due to non-detection in SCUBA and ALMA bands are shown (triangles,; see also).
For comparison, we overlay the $5~\sigma$ point-source imaging depths for each NIRCam broadband filter used in several JWST survey programs.

In the left panel of Figure 4, we show the dependence of the SED shape on the gas density ( $1\leq n_{0}/{\rm cm}^{-3}\leq 10^{3}$) at the sublimation radius, while the slope of its radial profile is fixed to $\gamma=0$.
The right panel of Figure 4 presents cases for a centrally concentrated density distribution with $\gamma=2$ and $\gamma=1$, alongside the case of $\gamma=0$ and $n_{0}=100~{\rm cm}^{-3}$
In each panel, we show the SEDs for cases without radiation feedback effects (dotted curves).
The left panel of Figure 7 shows the SEDs modeled with $\gamma=0.5$ for various AGN flux contributions from $f_{\rm AGN}=10\%$ to $100\%$.

findings.text: 采用猎户座星云和 AGN 复合谱消光律的模型能产生 LRD 的 v 形 SED，紫外斜率 β_UV~-2，而其他消光律无法维持紫外超额 [S2.p5]。在红外端，高密度（n0=10^3 cm^-3）或高集中度（γ=1-2）的尘埃分布会产生过亮的近红外辐射，与 MIRI 数据不符；较低密度（n0=10、100 cm^-3）使能量峰移到中远红外，与观测一致，但 n0=1 cm^-3 时远红外峰超过 ALMA 上限 [S3.p7][S3.p8]。综合三个条件，允许的参数空间约为 10^(2.9γ+0.83)≲n0/cm^-3≲10^3，且 γ<0.8 [S4.SS1.p4]。模型还表明，若宿主星系主导光学连续谱，所需恒星质量会与宇宙学框架冲突，而纯 AGN 模型可自然解释观测到的连续谱与 Hα 线通量关系 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p5]。

evidence.quote: Models with extinction laws observed in the Orion Nebula and AGN composite spectra flatten the SED with a UV slope of $\beta_{\rm UV}\sim-2$.
In contrast, other models result in strongly attenuated flux that fails to maintain a UV excess.
However, this extremely red SED color does not match the JWST MIRI photometric data for LRDs, which suggest a modest red color or even a flat spectral shape.
For the cases with $n_{0}=10$ and $100~{\rm cm}^{-3}$, the SED shapes from the optical band to $\lambda=2-3~\mu{\rm m}$ agree to the observed spectra of LRDs
As the density decreases to $n_{0}=1~{\rm cm}^{-3}$, the IR SED peaks at $\lambda\sim 100~\mu{\rm m}$ and exceeds the upper bounds obtained by ALMA observations.
Here, the density range is approximated as $10^{2.9\gamma+0.83}\lesssim n_{0}/({\rm cm}^{-3})\lesssim 10^{3},$ (5) which is valid $\gamma<0.8$.

However, if stellar light accounted for the continuum flux across the entire optical band, the required stellar mass would approach $M_{\star}\gtrsim 10^{11}~M_{\odot}$, comparable to that of the Milky Way.
This interpretation is indeed consistent with observations that the observed continuum and ${\rm H}\alpha$ line fluxes for LRDs follow the empirical correlation observed in nearby AGNs.

limitations.text: 作者明确指出，LRD 为何在 z>4 以统一的 A_V=3 mag 出现，目前没有明确答案，只能给出推测 [S4.SS4.p1]。模型假设全天覆盖（C=1），该值需在 LRD 与未遮蔽 AGN 的相对宇宙丰度以及 C 对 Eddington 比等 AGN 性质的依赖被更好理解后才能确定 [S3.p4]。关于尘埃散射导致变异性减弱的讨论，作者表示更详细的定量分析将在未来工作中进行 [S4.SS3.p2]。此外，模型未排除宿主星系的存在，只是表明仅考虑 AGN 的 SED 模型能成功捕捉 LRD 的特征谱性质 [S4.SS2.p5]。

evidence.quote: There is no clear answer to this question at this time, but some speculations are given below.

In our calculation, we assume a full-sky covering case (i.e., $C\equiv\Omega/4\pi=1$), while this value will be determined when the relative cosmic abundance between LRDs and unobscured AGNs and the dependence of $C$ on the AGN properties such as the Eddington ratio are better understood for LRDs.
A more detailed quantitative analysis of this scenario will be explored in future work.

Here, we emphasize that our approach does not rule out the existence of host galaxies in LRDs, but demonstrates that the SED model focusing only on AGNs successfully captures the characteristic spectral properties of LRDs
